summary: Sound that survives a headset switch, a faster Apple Silicon path, and safer file loading.

changes.title: Sound comes back by itself
changes.body: When the output device is removed and returns (a USB headset moved to another computer, for example), the sound resumes after a few seconds, and closing the game no longer stalls.

changes.title: Faster on Apple Silicon
changes.body: Tensor operations run on the GPU's cooperative matrices, with a MoltenVK built for it. Kokiri Forest on an M6 goes from about 30 to about 34 FPS.

changes.title: Ocarina of Time above 60 FPS
changes.body: FPS Unlock fixes Epona's fence jump, the day/night clock and the Deku Tree webs. The game no longer freezes after closing the R1 menu.

changes.title: Shaders
changes.body: Precompile All Shaders can be turned on for a game from its right-click menu. A shader cache from an earlier build keeps working; a few shaders are built again the first time the game draws them.

changes.title: Switch 2 games in HOME and better Edition support
changes.body: Launch games from HOME without installing them. Lichii better detects and launches Switch 2 Editions, applies matching upgrade packs, and keeps update information in NUPs.

changes.title: Damaged files
changes.body: KIP, NRO and NSO files are checked before they are loaded, and verifying a damaged NCA or NUP no longer hangs or runs out of memory.

changes.title: About this build
changes.body: This is a build of the zelda branch of danieljesus/Lichii, not an official Lichii release. Reopen these notes anytime from Help, even offline.
